emma_support: Customer ACME (acct_67890) on Growth plan reports 403 'Invalid API key' when calling /v1/embeddings. They rotated SSO yesterday. Request id: req_0a1b2c3d. Sample curl + response attached below. Can someone take a look?

rick_engineering: Can you paste the account id and the exact response body? Also did they change seats or billing recently?

emma_support: acct_67890, user: emma@acme.com. Billing shows active, last invoice paid. Raw response we got: `{"error":{"message":"Invalid API key","type":"invalid_request_error"},"status":403}`. Header had `x-request-id: req_0a1b2c3d`.

oliver_sre: Pulled entitlement logs for req_0a1b2c3d — gateway returned 403 but entitlement-service returned reason `plan_mismatch`. Gateway mapping surfaces this as invalid_key. Log snippet: ```
[2026-02-12T14:22:01Z] req=req_0a1b2c3d auth.gateway: token ok -> checking entitlement
[2026-02-12T14:22:01Z] req=req_0a1b2c3d entitlement.svc: result=DENY reason=plan_mismatch details="no_active_plan_for_user"
[2026-02-12T14:22:01Z] req=req_0a1b2c3d gateway: mapped_error=invalid_api_key status=403
```

rick_engineering: That's consistent with the SSO-seat sync race we tracked. If the SSO claim refresh happens before billing sync for that org we briefly see `no_active_plan` even though the billing UI shows active. Gateway mapping then hides the entitlement reason. Repro I used locally: 1) rotate SAML assertion for primary owner 2) trigger seat migration job 3) call embeddings within ~30s -> entitlement svc denies with plan_mismatch, gateway surfaces invalid_key.

jasmin_csm: Customer is blocked in prod and needs a quick workaround — they can't embed new docs.

rick_engineering: Short-term options: 1) ask customer to sign out/sign in to force claims refresh (fast) 2) run a manual tenant plan sync for acct_67890 (server side) 3) hotfix gateway to include entitlement reason in error body (riskier but clearer). I'll run a manual sync now if SRE agrees.

oliver_sre: Manual sync kicked off for acct_67890: job=5742. Status updates -> `started` -> `applied-billing-state` -> `completed`.

deploy-bot: Manual sync job 5742 completed in 3.2s.

emma_support: Asked customer to sign out/in and we also ran manual sync. Customer retried and reports success (no 403). Closing on the ticket. :thumbsup:

rick_engineering: I'll open an internal issue to make gateway surface entitlement reasons (and add metric for plan-sync-lag). Filing GH#1234 and assigning to infra-team. Follow-up: add metric + alert when plan-sync lag > 10s for any tenant.

jasmin_csm: Thanks team — I'll update the customer with the RCA and ETA for the hotfix.

emma_support: Closing thread — will reopen if customer sees recurrence.
